label: ADC reference voltage
intended_effect: defines characterized volts-per-count scaling
explicit_non_effects: does not tune any sensor or engine behavior

label: MAT/IAT installed
intended_effect: enables optional added MAT input
explicit_non_effects: disabled is not a sensor fault

label: Narrowband O2 installed
intended_effect: declares NB sensor physically available
explicit_non_effects: does not select feedback mode by itself

label: Wideband analog input installed
intended_effect: declares WB controller input physically available
explicit_non_effects: does not select feedback mode by itself

label: Knock sensing installed
intended_effect: declares knock path physically available
explicit_non_effects: does not set knock sensitivity

label: TPS voltage transfer
intended_effect: converts TPS voltage to throttle percent
explicit_non_effects: does not set idle or PE thresholds

label: MAP voltage transfer
intended_effect: converts MAP voltage to absolute pressure
explicit_non_effects: does not tune VE or load thresholds

label: MAT voltage transfer
intended_effect: converts optional MAT voltage to temperature
explicit_non_effects: does not tune MAT spark or density correction

label: CTS voltage transfer
intended_effect: converts CTS voltage to coolant temperature
explicit_non_effects: does not tune warmup enrichment

label: Wideband voltage transfer
intended_effect: converts controller voltage to measured lambda
explicit_non_effects: does not change lambda target or feedback gain

label: Battery input transfer
intended_effect: converts ADC input voltage to vehicle supply voltage
explicit_non_effects: does not tune key-off threshold

label: MAT fallback temperature
intended_effect: provides bounded control temperature when MAT unavailable or invalid
explicit_non_effects: does not masquerade as a valid MAT measurement

label: CTS fallback temperature
intended_effect: provides bounded control temperature when CTS invalid
explicit_non_effects: does not clear CTS invalid state

label: Battery fallback voltage
intended_effect: provides bounded voltage for calculations such as deadtime if battery measurement invalid
explicit_non_effects: does not assert key-off

label: REF events per crank revolution
intended_effect: defines reference pulse geometry and RPM scale
explicit_non_effects: does not change cylinder count or desired spark advance

label: REF to event TDC offset
intended_effect: aligns accepted REF edge coordinate to true event TDC
explicit_non_effects: does not mechanically change rotor phasing or retune spark table

label: REF events per engine cycle
intended_effect: reports two times configured REF events per crank revolution
explicit_non_effects: not independently editable

label: REF event spacing
intended_effect: reports 360 divided by REF events per crank revolution
explicit_non_effects: not independently editable

label: Combustion event spacing
intended_effect: reports 720 divided by cylinder count
explicit_non_effects: not independently editable

label: REF events per combustion event
intended_effect: reports REF event-cycle count divided by cylinder count
explicit_non_effects: unsupported scheduling ratios are configuration errors

label: Fuel delivery events per engine cycle
intended_effect: defines how requested cycle fuel is divided among delivery events
explicit_non_effects: does not change total requested fuel mass

label: Active injectors per delivery event
intended_effect: defines how event fuel mass is divided across active injectors
explicit_non_effects: does not change injector design flow
